text_original: The Library of Congress describes the New England clambake as a food tradition often associated with family reunions: participants gather at the seashore, build a large wood fire, and steam local clams, lobsters, and corn on the cob over the coals between layers of seaweed.
text_en: In the New England clambake tradition, often associated with family reunions, participants gather at the seashore and steam clams, lobsters, and corn over a wood fire and seaweed.

text_original: In 2024, full-time employed people who worked on a day averaged 8.1 hours on those days.
text_en: In 2024, full-time employed people who worked on a day averaged 8.1 hours on those days.

text_original: In 2024, 80% of employed people worked on an average weekday compared with 30% on an average weekend day.
text_en: In 2024, 80% of employed people worked on an average weekday compared with 30% on an average weekend day.

text_original: About 33% of employed people performed some work at home on days worked in 2024.
text_en: About 33% of employed people performed some work at home on days worked in 2024.

text_original: Among workers age 25 and over in 2024, people with a bachelor’s degree or higher were more likely to work at home than those with a high school diploma and no college.
text_en: Among workers age 25 and over in 2024, people with a bachelor’s degree or higher were more likely to work at home than those with a high school diploma and no college.

text_original: Multiple jobholders were more likely than single jobholders to work on an average weekend day in 2024.
text_en: Multiple jobholders were more likely than single jobholders to work on an average weekend day in 2024.
